Karrablast

Bug

Unova · Generation 5

Karrablast is a Bug-type Clamping Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 5.9 kg. It evolves into Escavalier. Its highest base stat is Attack (75), with a base stat total of 315.
